g.text: The ideal Otto cycle uses isentropic strokes and constant-volume heat transfer

g.text: Cold-air-standard ideal gas, constant heat capacities. 1→2 compression and 3→4 expansion are isentropic; 2→3 and 4→1 are constant-volume heat transfer. Illustrative
